name: @red-cup-engineering/relation-model-notation-named-codec
description: The named-variable surface syntax for Relation Model Notation: compileNamedRmn/parseNamedRmn and namedString/namedArray/namedObject/namedBool/namedGenerator admit a named surface (var/lam carry a name instead of a de-Bruijn index; resolved by ordinary lexical shadowing, innermost binder wins) and compile it to the closed de-Bruijn kernel, with namedOfCompiled/canonicalNamedRmn/digestNamedRmn as the reverse direction. Split out of relation-model-notation-reader-service, which was the admission gate AND this codec bundled together -- a codec and a gate are two different functions.
